name: sensor_patch_batch
description: Inspect up to eight RGB-D patches in one call. Points are normalized [row/(image_height-1), col/(image_width-1)] of calibrated agentview/wrist images, never mirrored policy images. Returns robust world coordinates, patch depth spread and offset from current EEF. Use to compare multiple visible surfaces and spot ambiguous depth edges before motion. Does not infer identity or success.
